item.text: {"analysis":"The trial timed out after 3,887.02 allocated GPU-seconds; the host returned no validation score. Predictive improvement, Electronics recovery, completion of all four categories, and scorer verification remain unconfirmed. The script's eight-hour internal deadline exceeded the host allocation, so its deadline logic did not ensure completion within this trial's budget. Future trials should align training deadlines with the available allocation while reserving time for all four categories and verification.","code_summary":"One independently trained RecurrentMemory model per category uses item embeddings, normalization, dropout, a GRU, candidate-conditioned causal attention, and a jointly trained item bias. The isolated change widens the scorer input from 3H to 5H by concatenating attended context, recurrent state, candidate embedding, and the two elementwise context/candidate and state/candidate products. Training retains masked sampled-softmax plus 0.2-weighted BCE, 32 negatives, temporal weighting, AdamW, and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor writer exports the same class through inspect.getsource and strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category; no ensemble or separately fitted scoring component is introduced."}
